text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh my... Good day, Nature-san. Are you interested in this cafe?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, not really. Just thought the line was crazy long.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: 'Limited Time! Yume-Kyun Cafe'... No wonder it's packed with so many sparkly, trendy girls...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My goodness! This is... I had always wished to visit with a friend, but between hospital visits, I never found the chance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Though it appears today is the final day...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (! ...Mnnn, Yume-Kyun, huh...?! Man... wait, but... gahh!!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: W-Well then, maybe I'll volunteer to come along! I was just getting curious about it myself!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Th-Then... I'll have... this. The Kyu... 'Kyun Love♪ Parfait'... please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...In that case, I shall take the 'Ikr☆ Okurrr Macaron'.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Please feel free to take a commemorative photo with your sweets~! Striking cute poses with your friend is our house tradition~♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —S-Sounds great, let's do it!! Shall we strike a pose, Ardan-san!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Since we came all this way! It'd be a waste not to enjoy every bit of it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Nature-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, yes. Excuse us, could you please take the photo?
(—Flash!)
Passing by the cafe, I spotted an unusually exhausted-looking Nice Nature and Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: S-Somehow pulled through...! That was a massive overdose of sparkly aesthetic...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It was such a delightful time. ...Though I fear I made you push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?! Push myself—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You are not particularly fond of such places, correct? You seemed rather shy and fidgety throughout.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I am so sorry. Properly speaking, I should have stopped you, yet—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Your kindness was simply so warm. I ended up leaning on it before I realized.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: A-Ahaha~! So you totally saw right through me~~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But you really don't need to apologize. I was just meddling on my own.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: B-Besides, we all help each other when in need! This is totally normal, completely normal!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, you truly are gentle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Just as McQueen told me. She mentioned how much you helped her the other day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Caring for others is a talent in its own right. And this Hachimii is a token of my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...N-No, seriously, cut it out. Honestly, I'm just a busybody!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Just as you cheered me up, I would like to be of help to you as well.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...W-Well, cheerleading is pretty much all I can do anyway.
